page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is-4x.16xlarge is a high-density accelerator instance equipped with an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Virtualized via KVM, the configuration provides 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512 GB of host memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 8 GB of RAM per vCPU. Computational acceleration is delivered by four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L20 GPUs, which supply a combined total of 192 GB of GDDR6 VRAM across the four discrete 48 GB accelerators.

Network operations are backed by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid inter-node data exchange in distributed environments. The instance carries no local storage volumes, requiring all primary operating systems, scratch spaces, and datasets to rely exclusively on remote cloud storage options. Furthermore, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance by default, requiring network address translation or elastic public IP configuration for public internet access.

The dense grouping of four L20 accelerators, extensive host memory, and wide 64 Gbps network pipeline establishes strong resource efficiency for medium-to-large artificial intelligence workloads. Because storage is fully decoupled from the physical compute nodes, cost efficiency in production depends on managing network-attached storage I/O without impeding the compute capabilities of the GPUs. The instance is structured for distributed model inference, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, data-intensive parallel analytics, and computer vision pipelines.
